changelog:
- Initial release of ginstall-oneclick skill.
- Supports one-click installation of GitHub Node.js repos using the ginstall CLI.
- Handles monorepo subpaths and accepts various GitHub URL formats.
- Provides guidance for private repo access using GITHUB_TOKEN.
- Interactive and automated usage modes supported with appropriate CLI flags.
summary: GInstall OneClick — one-click installation of GitHub projects: plan, clone, install Node deps, run dev scripts. Use when the user wants a GitHub Node.js repo...
